objective: Review the narrow observable-ordering helper implementation and decide whether the chain may move to defining a future execution boundary without treating ordering trace construction or launcher-start-allowed status as launcher execution, sidecar execution, compare evidence, timing evidence, broad native option support, arbitrary filelist support, automatic GPU allocation, runtime/ABI change, raw-state equality, direct Verilator sidecar execution, or production throughput evidence.

review_decision.reason: The implementation stays inside the reviewed non-executing helper boundary. It adds an importable helper in the existing bridge fixture module, validates the reviewed bridge metadata path through define_verilator_process_launcher_bridge_fixture, validates reviewed process-to-launcher metadata and explicit pulp_ita_mha 64x1 sidecar context, rejects unreviewed context refs, validates the exact structured run_hybrid_template.py argv, emits a monotonic observable ordering trace, and returns launcher-start-allowed status with all execution, compare, timing, runtime/ABI, allocation, and source-of-truth flags false.
review_decision.weakest_point: The helper name includes run and its output includes launcher-start-allowed status. That status is only a non-executing readiness signal emitted after ordering trace validation; it is not launcher process start, sidecar stage execution, bridge-path compare, timing, broad native option support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, direct Verilator sidecar execution, or production throughput proof.
accepted_because: the primary helper is importable and does not add a public CLI
the reviewed observable-ordering boundary gate is required before helper output is emitted
the helper reuses define_verilator_process_launcher_bridge_fixture instead of duplicating bridge validation
the helper validates reviewed process-to-launcher metadata before trace construction
explicit sidecar context and unreviewed context-ref rejection happen before launcher-start-allowed status
the observable trace events are monotonic and appear before launcher-start-allowed status
the launcher command remains exact structured argv for pulp_ita_mha 64x1
launcher process start, sidecar stages, compare, timing, public CLI, runtime/ABI, automatic allocation, and generated evidence as source of truth remain false

which helper output fields are preconditions for a future launcher start from structured argv

how bridge-path compare and timing claims remain blocked until later run gates

bridge-path coverage-output compare by this review gate
